primary_plan.selection: fixed final checkpoints, no seed selection; seed42 listening examples predetermined
primary_plan.limits: same-song sections; preconditioning changes input/output scaling and time loss weights together; no claim that regression improvement equals perception

calibrated_plan.evaluation: common y+sigma*epsilon, sigma=.02,.1,.5; t=prior_std/(prior_std+sigma); compare physical endpoint MSE, not velocity losses across priors
calibrated_plan.selection: fixed final3000, seed42 listening example predetermined; primary and unit6000 negative/positive outcomes retained

signal.limits: correlation is a bounded screen over stride-aligned windows; low scores do not exclude transformed memorization
